title: webhooks: signing secret undecryptable at boot before LocalCryptoProvider is wired (fail-closed transient)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Source: v18.4.0 sweep close-out, #32908 comment 6881136418 (devx#4 ledger, read at `87330e89`), routed by triage.

## What is wrong
Row 258 (record #33096 · 6851700388), item `integration-system.webhook-lifecycle`. During boot, a webhook that fires before `LocalCryptoProvider` is wired can't decrypt its signing secret. It fails closed, so nothing unsigned goes out, but the delivery is refused for a reason that is only boot order.

## Do
Wire the crypto provider before the webhook dispatcher can fire, or hold early deliveries until it is ready. Pin the boot order.

## Grade
**p2**: it fails closed and is transient.

## Reader
`domain:server`, pilot **Area E2** (webhooks).
